TRY: Testing different web IDE's

Many varieties of IDE are available to download and use for free. Others operate in the browser, giving the same functionality without a need to download.

  • Brackets

    Free

    Git Integration

    An easy modern text editor to design CSS rules while working with the website code live.

    https://phcode.dev/

  • Codespaces

    Free, limited

    Git Integration

    To work alongside a GitHub repository, the codespace launches the repository code live for browser editing.

    https://github.com/features/codespaces

  • Codio

    Instructor Set

    Advanced Features

    Used with modern learning spaces like Coursera, Codio features their web IDE for educational and instructional purposes.

    https://www.codio.com/

  • Cloud 9

    $1.00/90hours

    Advanced Features

    Amazon (AWS) cloud IDE with integrated cloud features.

    https://aws.amazon.com/cloud9/pricing/

  • JSFiddle

    Free

    Easy collaboration

    https://jsfiddle.net/

  • Replit

    Free

    Easy collaboration

    https://replit.com/

  • SourceLair

    $10/month

    1 DB server

    https://ide.sourcelair.com/home

AWS Cloud 9 is a cloud IDE, with many additional features from cloud involvement.
